scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n WEB,API -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace @golf/web" "npm run dev --workspace @golf/api"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @golf/api && npm run build --workspace @golf/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @golf/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @golf/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @golf/api && npm run lint --workspace @golf/web
